headword: {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}

definitions.explanation: The sale or release of a product before its general availability date, often limited to certain channels or customers.

examples.japanese: {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I got it through the advance sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{先行発売|せんこうはつばい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new game will be released early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先行発売|せんこうはつばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Through the members-only advance sale, you can purchase it a week before the general release.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{先行|せんこう}→先行：03773_senkou⟧ (preceding/going ahead) and ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ (sale/release). Common in marketing for music, games, books, and consumer electronics. The concept appeals to fans and early adopters who want products before the general public.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be released early
- {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: advance sale begins
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧{先行発売|せんこうはつばい}: members-only advance sale
- {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧: advance sale tickets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先行販売|せんこうはんばい}: advance selling (almost synonymous; ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ emphasizes the selling process)
- {予約販売|よやくはんばい}: pre-order sales
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧: release; putting on sale
- ⟦{先行予約|せんこうよやく}→先行予約：17983_senkouyoyaku⟧: advance reservation/pre-order
